results.snippet: When writing async code I often need to combine `CheckedContinuation` APIs with task cancellation. return try await withCheckedThrowingContinuation { continuation in. The missing piece is to unblock the suspended task on cancellation, using something like:. It is not easy to add this functionality because `withTaskCancellationHandler` is difficult to get right in a thread safe way. Also, automatic cancellation interferes with the requirement to resume the continuation exactly once. The `continuation` in the closure is a thread safe wrapper around `CheckedContinuation` which handles cancellation. Instead, is is passed as an argument to the closure of `with...Continuation` APIs. This is different in `CancellingContinuation`, mainly because of an implementation necessity: The cancellation handler needs something to address to before `continuation` can be accessed in the closure. Next to the established `with...Continuation` API there is a second way on how to use the new construct:. If so, I would probably go with operation handling cancellation of continuation, something like that probably:.
